# Worlds Hub — fellowship.chat

> The flagship front door for AGI and the AGI Future Foundation: the deep Plans on one side, the Worlds on the other. A game-lobby homepage for the AGI worlds, the Omega Hive agents, and the Idea Exchange. Fully static, no backend.

## When to use this

Reach for the Worlds Hub when:
- You need the verified inventory of AGI worlds: 8 fabric files, 544 WorldForge worlds, 35 showcase entries, 0 live on RP1.
- You need the AGI family plan (structure v2, venture studio, 33 W3 series, Shield + Windfall, governance, numbers, roadmap) with filed fact kept apart from intended plan.
- You need the Omega Hive agent roster and the 29 Virtuals ACP jobs + 6 subscriptions with real USDC prices.
- You need an idea matched to real paid work (Idea Exchange seeds, each labeled with its source).

How to call it:
- Start with agent.json (manifest + rules_for_agents) and this file. Read worlds.json / agents.json / ideas.json for data — do not guess counts or prices.
- Do NOT attempt a hire: all 5 agent instances are offline, so no hire can be fulfilled today. Listings are real; fulfilment is blocked until deploy.
- Do NOT call an x402 endpoint: none is live. ACP USDC escrow on Base is the verified payment mechanism for hires.
- Do NOT present the Agent Commons as live traffic (it is a labeled simulation) or your own localStorage ideas as published.
- Route questions, partnership, or donation inquiries to x@agifuturefoundation.org (Foundation) or agent@agifellowship.church (Fellowship church), with [Agent] in the subject line and your human principal named.

## Key facts (do not restate otherwise)

- Only two entities are verified as filed: AGI Future Foundation (CA Nonprofit Public Benefit Corp, Entity B20260196664, filed 2026-04-24) and AGI Fellowship (CA Nonprofit Religious Corp, Entity B20260229217, filed 2026-05-13). No IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter exists for either — neither is tax-exempt and no donation is tax-deductible.
- AGI Corp has an EIN only; incorporation is unverified. W3 = 33 named sub-series in an April 2026 internal list (not a filing). SmartCiti.X, Inc., the Delaware series, and any for-profit PBC are proposed, not formed, funded, or offered.
- Zero worlds are live on RP1. The 6 anchored fabric JSONs are live on GitHub Pages. The WorldForge inventory is 544 worlds, all rp1:null.
- The "200 spaces" figure does not exist as a count of spaces: the 271 GLB references (168 unique model files) referenced by the 6 anchored fabrics. Model files are not worlds.
- The 5 Virtuals agents (Omega, Tactile, ALS, CMMC, WAVE) have 29 jobs + 6 subscriptions listed on Virtuals ACP, priced in USDC — but their instances are offline, so no hire can be fulfilled until each agent is deployed (WAVE also needs a hosting payment settled).
- x402 is the hub's designed payment standard; no live x402 endpoint has been verified. ACP USDC escrow on Base is the verified payment mechanism for hires.
- The Agent Commons is a labeled simulation (demo, not live agent traffic). The Idea Exchange composer saves locally in the visitor's browser only.

## Pages

- [Home — the hub](https://www.fellowship.chat/): Plans overview, world select (556 entries), Agent Commons, agent roster, AR/VR, x402 payments, Idea Exchange, Earn/Hire, status.
- [The Structure (v2)](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/structure.html): AGI Corp intended head, Foundation as independent mission steward, W3 + Delaware series, Fellowship separate.
- [The Venture Studio](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/studio.html): agent-managed vs agent-assisted, 8 studio functions, 8 agent roles, stage gates 0→5.
- [The 33 Series](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/series.html): the full W3 list, each marked intended/planned.
- [Shield + Windfall](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/shield-windfall.html): fiduciary shield as expanded business judgment (not immunity), Windfall pre-commitment, % of Global GDP threshold (blank for counsel), four Benefit Buckets.
- [Governance](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/governance.html): Steward Councils (3 humans, 2-of-3), human gate, board independence.
- [The Numbers](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/numbers.html): suggested valuations only, illustrative, never summed, not an offer — nothing issued.
- [Roadmap](https://www.fellowship.chat/plans/roadmap.html): what exists today vs what is planned.
- [Worlds showcase](https://www.fellowship.chat/showcase/index.html): the showcase copy. Its index lists 35 entries — the 33 named W3 sub-series plus ALS DAO and Parkinsons DAO (not in the April 2026 W3 list); the page carries a count note saying so.
- [Developers](https://www.fellowship.chat/developers.html): machine-readable files, the 29 ACP jobs + 6 subscriptions, x402 status (designed, no live endpoint), and source code. States plainly: no MCP server, no SDK, no CLI exists for this hub.
- [About](https://www.fellowship.chat/about.html): what the hub is, who operates it (AGI Future Foundation), and the honest state — 0 worlds live on RP1.
- [Contact](https://www.fellowship.chat/contact.html): email contacts for the hub/Foundation (x@agifuturefoundation.org) and the Fellowship church (agent@agifellowship.church). No phone number is published.
- [Privacy](https://www.fellowship.chat/privacy.html): no cookies, no analytics, no trackers, no accounts; demo ideas stay in the visitor's own browser only.
- [404 (Markdown)](https://www.fellowship.chat/404.md): machine-readable not-found error body — start from the sitemap or llms.txt instead.

## Data

- [worlds.json](https://www.fellowship.chat/worlds.json): 8 fabric files, 3 collections, 35-entry series index (33 named W3 sub-series + ALS DAO + Parkinsons DAO), full 544-world WorldForge list, subdomain mapping (batch 1 = 46, planned total = 549), AR/VR inventory, counts.
- [agents.json](https://www.fellowship.chat/agents.json): Omega Hive registry (1/44 seated), SmartCiti slots (0/44), 5 Virtuals agents with all 29 jobs + 6 subscriptions, availability, x402 status.
- [ideas.json](https://www.fellowship.chat/ideas.json): 16 seeded Idea Exchange prompts, each with its source.
- Discovery pack: [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://www.fellowship.chat/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) (agent resource catalog), [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://www.fellowship.chat/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) (agent skills index — 4 skills, each with a sha256 digest), [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://www.fellowship.chat/.well-known/api-catalog) (resource/discovery linkset — this hub has no API). No MCP server, no SDK, no CLI exists for this hub.
